description:
[Interviews] Get the definition/configuration of an interview (position), including its ordered `questions` array. The questions come back in the same format create_interview_from_questions accepts, so you can read an interview here, change the array, and send it to update_interview. Each question's `id` identifies it — keep the ids you did not mean to change.

Retrieves the interview definition for a given interview-definition id or position id. Returns the compiled `calc_definition_json`, the ordered `questions` array (in the same format job-interview-create-from-array accepts, so it round-trips into job-interview-update) plus basic metadata. Access is subject to the caller's row-level security.

conversation_id.description: Pass the exact conversation_id from the server's previous response, unchanged. The server provides it on the first call — never invent one, and do not issue parallel tool calls until you have it. Keep passing the same conversation_id for the rest of the conversation, including after later user messages or on a different task; do not reset it when the user starts a new request.

position_id.description: Identifier of either an interview definition (single-stage) or a position definition (multi-stage). The function resolves whichever matches.

name: get_interview_definition

calc_definition_json.description: The compiled interview definition JSON (structure varies by interview type).

candidate_expectations.description: Free-text candidate expectations. Null for multi-stage positions.

candidate_expectations_json.description: Structured candidate expectations JSON — the scoring rubric. Null for multi-stage positions.

candidate_notification_channel.description: SMS / WhatsApp candidate notifications: null = off, reminders = with both e-mail reminders, last_reminder = only with the final reminder, all = invitation + reminders + pre-screening accepted.

candidate_video_introduction.description: Whether a candidate video introduction is hidden/optional/required. Null for multi-stage positions.

coach_plan.description: Coaching-plan stage this session belongs to. Null for multi-stage positions and for sessions outside any plan.

country_availability.description: Portal availability by the candidate's country: {countries_allowed?: string[], countries_allowed_eu?: boolean, countries_blocked?: string[], countries_blocked_eu?: boolean} (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, EU = EU + EEA + Switzerland; blocked wins), judged by the candidate's IP on the portal; invited candidates keep access. Null = not used, every country. Set it with job-interview-update.

creation_parameters.description: The creation parameters recorded at build time (interview_type, interview_tone, interview_length, additional_context, include_rapport_question, include_closing_prompt, knowledge_base_store_id, seniority_level, hiring_for_company).

environment.description: Which webhook environment this interview's results are delivered to. Null for multi-stage positions, whose stages each carry their own.

interview_available_till.description: ISO date/time after which the interview is no longer available to candidates. Null means always available.

interview_conversation_speed.description: Conversation pace of the AI avatar (slower/normal/faster). Null keeps the template default. Null for multi-stage positions.

interview_description_long.description: Long description (create/update field `description_long`). Rendered as Markdown on the candidate-facing position page — formatting guide: https://developer.jobmojito.com/cookbooks/format-content-with-markdown

interview_salary.description: Salary range shown for the position.

interview_template_id.description: Interview template id. For multi-stage positions this is the first interview step's template.

interview_template_type.description: Type of the linked interview template. `interactive_elevenlabs` is voice-only; the others (`interactive_spatius`, `interactive_heygen`, `offline_heygen`, `offline_elai`, `offline_synthesia`) are avatar-based. Null when the template could not be resolved.

is_multistage.description: True when the id resolved to a multi-stage position rather than a single interview.

is_voice_only.description: Convenience flag derived from interview_template_type: true when voice-only (`interactive_elevenlabs`), false when avatar-based, null when the template type could not be resolved.

knowledge_base_store_id.description: Linked knowledge base store id. Null for multi-stage positions.

max_duration.description: Live session limit in seconds. Null for multi-stage positions.

max_followups.description: Maximum number of AI follow-up questions; null uses the template default. Null for multi-stage positions.

pdf_export_auto_config.description: Auto-PDF-report options applied when the interview completes; null when auto-export is off. Null for multi-stage positions.

questions.description: The interview questions, in the order they are asked, in the same format job-interview-create-from-array accepts — so this array can be edited and sent straight back to job-interview-update, or used to create a copy of this interview. Each `id` is the question's real identifier: send it back unchanged and the question keeps its existing record (and with it its answer rules and any rendered avatar video). The welcome, thank-you and instructional-video steps are NOT included — they are not questions in this format, and job-interview-update leaves them untouched. Null for multi-stage positions, whose questions live on the individual interview stages.

candidate_expectations_json.description: Per-question candidate expectations, bucketed by requirement level (weak/moderate/strong). Extra keys are preserved.

moderate.description: Requirements expected of a solid, competent candidate.

strong.description: High-bar requirements only standout candidates clear.

weak.description: Baseline requirements every viable candidate should meet (table stakes).

conditional_question_main_id.description: For a conditional question, the id (the "id" field above) of the parent question in this same array that triggers it. The parent must appear earlier in the array than the conditional question referencing it.

duration.description: Answer duration in seconds for this question.

external_data.description: Arbitrary JSON metadata stored on the question.

external_id.description: External identifier stored on the question. job-interview-update matches on this first, so an ATS that owns stable ids can send its own array and have the diff line up without round-tripping our ids.

id.description: Identifier for this question. job-interview-get returns the question's real id here; send it back to job-interview-update so an unchanged question keeps its existing record (and with it its answer rules and any rendered avatar video). Also the handle another question references via conditional_question_main_id. On job-interview-create-from-array it is a caller-local value, only needed for those references.

is_conditional.description: Conditional follow-up question (view 'with listening conditional'). Use with conditional_question_main_id.

is_without_scoring.description: Question is asked but not scored (view 'without scoring').

knowledge_base_id.description: Knowledge-base store id (uuid) the question draws context from.

label.description: Optional label/tag stored on the question.

mojito_language_code.description: Per-question language override (one of the platform-languages.json codes). Inherits the interview language when omitted.

question.description: The question text shown to the candidate.

questions_random_subset.description: Fraction of the questions actually asked (0.01-0.9); null asks all of them. Null for multi-stage positions.

recording.description: Per-answer recording mode. Null for multi-stage positions.

recording_full_session.description: Full-session recording mode. Null for multi-stage positions.

recruiter_profile_id.description: Profile id of the recruiter owning this interview/position.

required_pronunciation.description: Whether a pronunciation assessment is required. Null for multi-stage positions.

result_enable_edit_transcript.description: Whether the candidate may edit the transcript on the result view. Null for multi-stage positions.

result_scoring.description: Resolved result-scoring config (update field `custom_scoring`; its `max_retries` is the update field `interview_attempts`). Null means the platform defaults apply. Null for multi-stage positions.

result_view.description: Result view level. Null for multi-stage positions.

slug.description: URL slug of the public listing, when one was generated.

speech_language_code.description: Azure speech language code. Null for multi-stage positions.

speech_language_name.description: Azure speech language display name. Null for multi-stage positions.

stage.description: Hiring-pipeline stage. Null for multi-stage positions.

tags.description: Free-form tags. Also the coaching-catalogue mapping key: a catalogue directory lists this session when its `tags_interview_set_filter` is a subset of these tags. Null for multi-stage positions.

type.description: Interview type. Null for multi-stage positions.

type_credit.description: Credit bucket the interview draws from. Null for multi-stage positions.

visibility.description: Who can see and access the interview/position.

title: Get interview definition
